visual.title: Greedy colouring, one vertex at a time
visual.caption: Each vertex takes the smallest colour no neighbour already has. The odd cycle forces a third colour, and the chord makes sure the greedy order cannot avoid it.

predict.question: How many colours does the greedy colouring of this graph use?
predict.explain: An odd cycle needs three colours. The chord joins two vertices at distance two, so a two-colouring would give adjacent vertices the same colour.
